fullPassage: The idea that our senses may be deceiving us was taken up by the French philosopher and mathematician René Descartes. He realized that sometimes our senses give us a false impression — a straight stick in a glass of water appears to be bent, for example. And if we know that they can be unreliable, it would be wrong to trust them completely — everything that we experience with our senses might be false. It might even be that we are asleep, and that the world we are experiencing is no more than a dream, or that God or some mischievous power is making us believe things that are not really true. If that is the case, though, we can never know anything for sure. But Descartes then showed that there was one thing he could be sure of: In order to be deceived, he must exist, and exist as a thing that thinks. So, although his senses could not be trusted, he could be sure he existed as something that was capable of thinking and reasoning.

And if we know that they can be unreliable, it would be wrong to trust them completely — everything that we experience with our senses might be false. It might even be that we are asleep, and that the world we are experiencing is no more than a dream, or that God or some mischievous power is making us believe things that are not really true. If that is the case, though, we can never know anything for sure. But Descartes then showed that there was one thing he could be sure of: In order to be deceived, he must exist, and exist as a thing that __________. So, although his senses could not be trusted, he could be sure he existed as something that was capable of thinking and reasoning.

det.korean: 사고하는 존재로서 존재해야 한다: a thing that ____
det.analysis:
❌ ① sleeps: '잠자는' 것은 존재 증명의 핵심이 아님
✅ ② thinks: '사고하는' 것은 데카르트 코기토의 핵심 ←정답
❌ ③ dreams: '꿈꾸는' 것은 의심의 대상이지 증명이 아님
❌ ④ speaks: '말하는' 것은 사고 존재와 무관
det.tip: I think, therefore I am. a thing that thinks = 사고하는 존재

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① 감각을 완전히 신뢰해야 한다: 감각 불신이라는 글의 흐름과 정면 반대
❌ ② 우리의 꿈이 현실이 된다: 논리적 귀결이 아님. 꿈일 수 있다는 가정일 뿐
✅ ③ 확실한 것은 절대 알 수 없다: 감각이 모두 거짓일 수 있다면 확실한 건 없다는 논리적 귀결 ←정답
❌ ④ 수학이 모든 것을 증명한다: 감각 불신 맥락과 완전히 무관
det.tip: 논리적 귀결: 감각이 모두 거짓일 수 있다면 → 확실한 것은 없다
